**주제****:** [TCF08_216] IGLOO Spider OT - Collaboration with Korean Shipowners on Cyber Resilience

Dear Sir

Thanks for the meeting today.

Here are some points that I remember from our discussions :

- JDP contract draft to be submitted to HO Cyber then to legal before signature
- It’s a tripartite JDP (BV, IGLOO, shipowner or association of shipowners)
- JDP contract draft must be kept as simple as possible : IGLOO to provide documentation he’s able to provide shipowner (on a real-case vessel), BV to review this documentation according to UR E26 (CYBER RESILIENT) requirements and provide comments
- JDP contract draft to mention deliverable (AiP), which will be focused on compliance of IGLOO NMS provided documentation with all or part of the UR E26 requirements
- This JDP can be announced at MARINTEC, even if not completed, as long as JDP contract is officially signed

I confirm I’ll be in Korea **from Nov 23rd to Nov 30th** to meet all the shipowners and suppliers you think are important for us to meet.

Panagiotis will confirm or not his presence during the same period by separate e-mail.

Best regards
